nom: belif Aqua Bomb Hydrating Sleeping Mask with Panthenol

avis.texte: I use a chemical exfoliant at night so I'm always looking for an extra hydrating sleeping mask to layer with. This one is nice: an interesting, bouncy, jelly texture. It does leave my skin feeling a little tacky, but since I'm just going to sleep, it doesn't bother me. I don't feel especially moisturised in the morning, but I don't feel dry, either, and it doesn't irritate my skin. I'm not mad at it, but I'm not going to be running to repurchase, either.

This is my favorite all-time nighttime skin mask. It has a jelly texture but dries quite nicely, leaving your skin feeling extremely hydrated and moisturized. I have tried other nighttime masks from different brands, but this definitely is my favorite. I use this a few times a week, maybe even more during the wintertime or days that I have been out in the sun for a long time to get my skin feeling extra hydrated again at bedtime. A little goes a long way as well. This jar lasts forever!
This is my go-to nighttime moisturizer for winter. It does take some time to absorb but well worth it for the moisturizing results.

I have not finished the jar yet. Maybe it is really dry, but my skin the next morning is not noticeably any more hydrated then if I use a night cream. I have tried this alone and also over a serum. Not blown away, but I will say it did not irritate my skin.
Are there more stars to give?????? I am absolutely in love with this mask it looks and feels like pudding, but when you put it on, it's like a hug with a cloud. Absolute heaven.
I like this a lot but like the Super Knights multi vitamin mask better.

I use this at least once a week at night and it is extremely hydrating for my dry skin. It has a cooling effect and a little goes a long way, so the jar lasts me a while! I wake up with glowy skin. Love this product!

I alternate this with Kiehl's Squalane overnight mask. I use this about 3x per week either at night or after a midday workout as a 20 minute face mask. It helps give a glow, but it also helps clear blemishes. I am still on the same jar I purchased over 3 months ago. It's definitely worth the price.
This really is the only brand I can use for my oily skin. The jelly is great for areas that need that extra hydration without being too much. It absorbs well and doesn't make you feel super oily.
I absolutely loved this mask! It's so hydrating. I will definitely be purchasing this in the future. It has a fresh scent and nice sleep packaging.
Overall this product is effective i like the look of my skin when i wake up but the sticky feeling really bugs me so for that reason its just okay for me
It did not have much of a decent which was good for sleeping with and I liked the packaging because It was easy to open it was smooth on my sensitive skin and didn't give me any irritation

It really does hold in the hydration! I put this over my regular moisturizer before bed. It sealed everything very comfortably & stated on my face without wiping off on my pillow. Super satisfied with the results!

This is my favorite overnight moisturizer ive ever gotten. I like to use chemical exfoliaters which makes my skin dry, and this is perfect for applying. I love the jelly consistency and can tell this jar is going to last a while, a little goes a long way.

If you have dry skin that often flakes this is mandatory in your routine. my makeup turns out so well when i use this mask the night before. this reaaaally hydrates your skin and makes my skin so smooth and soft in the morning. does not break you out. its worth every penny and little goes a long way!!! just BUY IT

avis.titre: Optimal product for alternating with retinol use
avis.texte: Optimal Product for Alternating with Retinol Use I've been using the Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask for nearly a week. To use, apply a thin layer after your moisturizer to lock in hydration overnight; the consistency should resemble that of jelly or pudding. The following morning, rinse it . Despite this, I would recommend this product to individuals using retinol, glycolic acid, lactic acid, or any treatment that leaves their face excessively dry, requiring maximum moisture retention.
I love how moisturizing belif products are. They help control my oil and prevent any acne from popping up. I have dry skin in the winter and this is a staple
This product give the right amount of moisture without overdoing it and becoming greasy. I would definitely recommend this product to others!
CRAZYYY HOW MUCH THIS PRODUCT CHANGED MY LIFE. I LOVE IT AND RECOMMEND TO EVERYONE READING This!!! so happy I got the chance to try this and will be buying soon

I bought a bag at ulta filled with nighttime face products and this one was one of my FAVORITES, one I will be using for a long time as I love waking up with such a good feeling face what a great way to start the day and to take care of my skin at night especially during this rough winter

I got this product in a sample size and I fell in LOVE!! Price point is a little higher than I normally buy but it's worrh it!!! Very Hydrating! 💦 The jelly like texture was a little weird at first, but it feels Amazing going on and doesn't leave a greasy oily residue. Literally feels like a tall glass of water for face! Smell is light and calming. I will most definitely continue to buy this as needed!
I love this mask because it is extremely soothing and cooling.Tje product has little to no scent which provides great comfort whilst going to to bed

I would buy this product again it's great I loge how soft and smooth it left my skin the texture is thick and kinda like a jelly over all it's a great product I have sensitive acne prone skin but it didn't give me anything
Belif Aqua bomb sleeping mask is outstanding. Makes my skin so soft, i absolutely love it. Will definitely be recommending to all my friends and family.

I cannot emphasize enough how much I adore this product. The Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask is genuinely a skincare dream encapsulated in a compact container. From the moment of application, I experienced an unparalleled sensation of refreshment, deep moisturization, and a soothing coolness on my skin. I am genuinely captivated by its efficacy. If you haven't yet experienced this remarkable product, I firmly believe you are overlooking a transformative skincare gem. Don't miss out!!!
This was so hydrating! This is one of my favorite moisturizers. I will definitely be repurchasing this. I use this almost every single night it's so good.
Wow, this product is amazing! When waking up my skin stays glowy throughout the day and looks so hydrated! Will be buying more of this product. Would highly recommend

I absolutely love this sleeping mask. It really is a must to hydrate your skin. I love how nice, soft, and cool it feels on the skin when I apply it. My skin feels so hydrated and looks glowing when I wake up. I definitely recommend it. Specially now during winter when my skin tends to get really dry.
This mask is lovely. The smell is light and fresh, and the benefits can be felt within one use. I woke up feeling refreshed and my skin looked great.
Love using this! My skin looks so plump the next day. It's perfect for the winter months since it's hydrating. Will be repurchasing this going forward.
I really enjoyed using this product. It is very moisturizing and light weight. I will continue using this and see what the results are like over time.
Belif is my favorite for skincare. I love everything they come out with and I was super excited to try and definitely did not disappoint obsessed!!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I'm really loving this product! A little goes a long way, so though the packaging is small, it lasts a long time. Works well as a mask during sleep, but also a dab can be a moisturizer for the daytime. No scent. Would repurchase.

avis.titre: Nice product if you are not sensitive!
avis.texte: This product did not work for me as my skin is very sensitive to scents, however, it may work really well for you if you are not! It has a very pleasant spa like scent. It does provide nice hydration and is very comfortable. Not oily or greasy at all.
I am seriously in love with this sleeping mask, It keeps my skin so hydrated overnight and i love how moisturizing it is. It really works wonders if you have dry skin. I would highly recommend!
It felt very moisturizing and fresh, overall felt great on the skin. Was worried about sleeping with it on, but it worked very well, didn't smear anywhere.

I loved using the Aqua bomb sleeping mask , the texture glided in my face so smoothly , no build up feeling left in my face . When washing my face as directed in the morning my skin was supple and so moisturized !! This product was different from others I used because it had me wash my face in the morning which made a nice difference in the outcome ! I would definitely purchase this product for myself or a gift for a friend . I will definitely continue to use this product . New customer for life !!! Aqua bomb was a great new find .
Love this mask for nights when I'm feeling especially dry - it's also perfect for use with tretinoin, which I always need a little extra hydration when using.

I'm don't have anything bad to say about this product, but the texture really throws me! It's like jello. I enjoyed using it and felt moisture with no oily feel. I've only been using it a week and would like to use it longer to see if it makes a major difference in my skin's moisture or not.

The belif in truth aqua bomb sleeping mask presents a delightful skincare experience. Its unique jelly-like texture not only feels cool and refreshing but also absorbs seamlessly into the skin. Despite a slight residual tackiness, the resulting glowy sheen enhances the overall radiance. One notable aspect is the subtle herbal fragrance that accompanies application, providing a calming touch to the bedtime ritual. As the night unfolds, the mask works its magic, leaving the skin feeling remarkably smooth and thoroughly moisturized by morning. This product strikes a balance between hydration and lightweight comfort, making it suitable for various skin types. If you appreciate waking up to a revitalized complexion, the belif aqua bomb sleeping mask might be a welcome addition to your skincare repertoire.
I enjoyed testing this! I thought the texture of the product was great and I enjoyed the feeling of it on my skin. Didn't feel heavy or sticky at all

I live in Texas the weather always dries out the skin but speaking of belif it is one of the brands that has not left me behind it is the number one in skin care it gave me explosive hydration on my dull skin it gave me a radiant glow I applied one thin layer before going to sleep and rinse in the morning and when removing waoouuu surprise too much moisture fresh and shiny

I'd recommend for those with oily skin as this goes on very light. Almost too light. The consistency is kinda like soft jello. i tend to like heavy cream based overnight masks. when I mixed this with the laneige water mask, i like the results better

avis.titre: Super hydrating + gentle on my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I got this product at the absolute right time. I had noticed that this winter my skin was even drier than ever. I started getting the really dry, white patches on my face no matter how much moisturizer I used. With just the first use I noticed my skin was much plumper and way less dry in the morning! I've been using it about three weeks now and generally rotate it in my skincare routine. So most times I use its every other night. It's a jelly like consistency on the thick side. I do appreciate with the consistency every time I open the container it looks brand new again because it all comes back together. 😂 I used to love the Kiehl's Water Cream and this does basically the same thing for me as far as moisturizing my skin! Also worth noting that it was really gentle in my face and I have really sensitive skin.
I used it before bed. And it's wonderful. My skin shined. My face was so soft and smooth.

I love this mask. It has a jelly water like consistency. I love that you wash off the mask in the morning and works all night. After washing face in the morning my skin feels soft and clean. A little goes a long way. It deeply hydrated my dry skin.

Received the Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask in exchange for my honest review. The aqua bomb is a jelly like substance for your face with the smell of being at the spa. I take a little and add to my face before bed for some aromatherapy and moisture. Keeps my skin feeling moisturized and a nice little treat! Really pleasantly surprised by how calming it is to add before bed. If I had any feedback, it was hard to open the packaging, but finally got it open!

avis.titre: I would buy this again, really makes a difference
avis.texte: I wasn't sure about this and how well it would work but I do think it's made a big difference in how moisturized my face feels in the mornings. It also seems to maybe plump up my skin and helps it look more refreshed. It does have a slight lavender sort of smell, which is not my favorite, but it doesn't last and it does fade quickly.

This is the perfect product for winter! Delivers extreme hydration without leaving skin oily or greasy. Works great for both dry and combination skin. My makeup looks flawless the next day after applying it- my skin looks so smooth and plump. Will be using the sleeping mask all winter long!

I use this one every single night . It's totally perfect for me. The smells is ok . Not too strong . When i apply to my skin . It makes my skin hydrates .even when i wake up in the morning my skin still glow. Not dry like before. It's light , not too heavy on your face . I highly recommend it .will buy it again

avis.titre: It was okay but not the best
avis.texte: I don't really like sleeping masks to begin with but I did like this one a little bit. It's not the best I've tried but also not the worst. If you like sleeping masks, you should try this out.
I have super dry skin so I needed something that could help me while I slept so I could wake up ready for the day. I use this every night and my skin has never looked so hydrated

I wasnt so sure about sleeping in this product. I was worried it would feel sticky or gross on my skin and against my pillow. I was wrong! This product felt so light and moisturizing on my skin that i almost forgot to wash it off in the morning. Once rinsed and I prep my skin for makeup im reminded this is a game changer! My skin was hydrated and poreless! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
This mask is refreshing and helps hydrate your skin well also providing lots of moisture to your skin. The sleep bomb mask is easy to use and simple to apply on skin

I was a bit skeptical about this to be honest because it feels like jello in the jar but oh boy was I wrong! This sleeping mask has honestly revolutionized my night routine in the best way possible! It only take a tiny bit and that goes a long way, you lightly massage it into the skin (I tap it in once it's been distributed) and you're done! You wake up to an insanely hydrated face!
I received this and tried it and omg it is absolutely amazing

This product does a great job of creating that "woke up fresh" feeling to the skin. I have very sensitive skin, so I was concerned about this product because similar ones in the past have caused micro breakouts on my cheeks, however this one has not done that so far. I do find that it works better to hold in moisture overnight if I use my moisturizer first, allow it to dry down, and then apply this mask. I still have to apply moisturizer in the morning after rinsing off the mask, however my skin feels immediately smooth and soft when initially cleansed. It took new a few days to get the correct amount for application--if you use too much, it takes forever to dry down and feels tacky all night. When you get it right though, it feels slightly tacky, but does not transfer onto clothing, pillows, or hair. Overall, the amount given in the jar is generous due to the fact that a little goes a long way. The one thing I would perhaps like to be distributed with the mask is a small spatula or spoon to allow for easier removal from the jar. Because of the consistency, sometimes it slides around and is hard to pick up.

This product gave so much hydration after just one use! I love the consistency and will continue to use this all winter long as my skin dries out with the change in season. I really like how it works overnight so I don't have to do anything other than put it on, forget about it, and wash it off. It does have quite a bit of fragrance but it's not overwhelming.

I used this both in the harsh, cold weather of New England alongside a vacation to Miami and this mask had the same results- bouncy, dewy, glowing hydration! I have super dry skin that is exacerbated by cold weather and after applying this mask post-retinol I would wake up with such soft, hydrated skin. It was just as effective as a moisturizing treatment after a day in the South Florida sun. I recommend it to anyone who wants to wake up looking dewy and refreshed!

THis sleep mask is very nourishing and a great complement to my skincare. I used tretinoin on most nights so it's very important to keep my skin not only hydrating but well moisturized. This mask as a last step in my routine ensures that my skin doesn't suffer from transpepidermal water loss at night and I wake up with soft, bouncy skin.

This came at the perfect time with the dryer and colder weather. I have dry/combination skin but it gets very dry in the winter. I've used this product in the past and loved it, but I just forgot about it until now. I think belif has some great products but the lack of marketing makes them a bit forgettable which is a shame. The texture of this can throw people off cause it's like a jelly consistency, but it is very good at moisturizing the skin. I do my skincare routine and after moisturizer I apply this before bed. All you need is a very thin layer, so you don't have to worry about it getting on your sheets/pillow case. It has helped immensely with my dry skin. I would absolutely recommend this product!

The texture of the mask is lightweight and gel-like, which absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy or sticky residue. The formula contains a powerful blend of natural ingredients including Lady's Mantle and Scottish Heather, which work together to provide hydration and soothe the skin. After applying the mask, I really appreciate that product doesn't leave any residue on my pillows, which means that I wake up with moisturized and glowing skin. This mask has truly transformed my skin, leaving it feeling hydrated, soft and supple when I wake up in the morning. I recommend trying the Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask to anyone who is looking for an effective, nourishing and hydrating skincare product. It is perfect for those who want to wake up to beautiful-looking skin by infusing your skin with moisture. This product is definitely worth a try for those looking for a luxurious yet affordable way to elevate their skincare regimen.

I like this mask, this mask very nice and hydrated I recommend this mask, my skin after this mask is glowing Like it, you have to try it, ……………………….
Received from BzzAgent for free and I am very excited to have this as my new favorite product it smells great it makes my skin soft and glowing

This sleeping mask made my skin extra soft. It seemed to lock in moisture well overnight. I washed my face first, then applied moisturizer, then applied a thin layer of this sleeping mask. Then washed it off in the morning. Plus it smells nice and has a pleasant jelly texture.

I got this item for free to review, and I will say I honestly do like how soft my face is after using it. It's super easy to use, and it smells nice. A little product goes a long way (love that!) and I like the container it comes in! My face looks a lot smoother too.

I use this in my p.m. routine I apply this after moisturizing. It isn't sticky or greasy and abosrbs pretty quickly as well. When I wake up in the morning and wash this off, holy moly, does my skin feel so good! I highly recommend this! Especially if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: This product was so fun to apply
avis.texte: I loved trying out the Belif Aqua bomb sleeping mask! I have very dry skin in the New England winters and this product was awesome! The texture of it was so unique and like nothing I have ever tried before. It is like a big gelatinous pillow of hydration that bounces when you touch it. I have been using this for about two weeks, and it's so fun to attach to my finger once I press down and it jiggles away. The mask itself is clear, the packing is very easy to open, and the hydration works great. Even though it's a sleep mask, I've been applying in the morning and at nights, and my skin feels hydrated and healthy. It absorbs very quickly without irritation. I love the instant hydration and dewy glow from using the Aqua Bomb Sleep Mask! Please note, I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: I totally love this stuff! Better than I expected!

You wouldn't think that by the texture of what the product is inside of the container that it would go so smoothly on the skin! It makes my skin feel nice and hydrated before bed and I don't wake up feeling like I have dry skin and even after I wash my face in the morning...it still feels hyrdrated and not dry. I LOVE this stuff, and would highly recommend it!

I put it on after a shower and moisturizer. It left my skin hydrated the next morning! I only applied a thin layer and it felt refreshing. My skin looks soft and refreshed.

Simply put, it does when it says, it hydrates your skin fully and diminishes fine lines and it gives you a beautiful glow while leaving your face feeling as smooth as a baby's skin. This is a product that you must try.

You can pinch out some of the jelly and it spreads really nicely over the skin. It feels so hydrating and my skin was glowing when I awoke. I've been using it for over a week and have noticed a significant improvement in the overall appearance and dryness of my skin. Love this!

I have combination skin and this took care of my dry skin without over moisturizing my oily skin. I loved the jelly like texture it went on my skin nicely. It fully absorbed into my skin and didn't leave residue on my pillow.

I've been looking for a GOOD sleeping mask for a while and I'm just so grateful I get to tried this mask. Firstly, I love the jelly texture and the relaxing smell if the mask. My skin just feels so soft in the morning and it's doesn't leave my skin oily and itchy likes the one one from a different brand I've tried. I will definitely repurchase this mask and highly recommended this mask for everyone I know.

I've been having a few dry patches on my skin & all ima say is as I'm using this (even bought another) it HELPS so much. I wake up my skin feeling EVENLY hydrated & love the consistency cause my skin doesn't feel GREASY it feels hydrated/bouncy/fresh it absorbs nicely so I don't have to worry about going to bed with a weird wet/sticky face

avis.titre: The most moisturizing overnight face mask!
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin, I put on this Belif aqua bomb sleeping mask at nights after I cleanse my face and follow up with my night time skincare routine. (Usually consisting of toner, eye cream, serums, and moisturizers.) I put this on as a last step on top of the moisturizer and it feels amazing! My face feels so much more moisturized and bouncy when I wake up in the morning compared to when I don't use this.
It has a nice gel hydrating application to the skill leaving my skin moisturized the whole night. It helps with giving me the morning glow that I love and a lot of my dry patches clear up

avis.titre: Optimal Product for Alternating with Retinol Use
avis.texte: I've been using the Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask for nearly a week. To use, apply a thin layer after your moisturizer to lock in hydration overnight; the consistency should resemble that of jelly or pudding. The following morning, rinse it off to reveal noticeably smoother and baby-soft skin. I appreciated the improved texture and enhanced hydration of my face the next day. This product is particularly beneficial when alternating with retinol to combat dryness and irritation that retinol may induce. However, I am uncertain if I want to incorporate this additional step into my already complex nighttime routine. The consistency didn't absorb as quickly as I expected, prompting me to place a towel on my pillow as a precaution against potential staining. The sticky feeling it left after application was not preferable; I had anticipated a faster-absorbing gel-like sensation. Despite this, I would recommend this product to individuals using retinol, glycolic acid, lactic acid, or any treatment that leaves their face excessively dry, requiring maximum moisture retention.
I use this at night time and wake up with a such a plump face in the morning! My face is super hydrated and soooo smooth! I only use this about twice a week and is so luxurious!!!
I used this when I was having some problems with really dry skin and it hydrated my face so well! I would highly recommend this product to anyone having issues with dry skin!
I loved this moisturizer! Gentle and effective and has a nice light scent. I have sensitive skin that is pretty dry from being on accutane, and this was amazing to slather on before bed!

and you don't even need much product. it goes on sticky but after a few minutes it sinks into my skin and by the time I wake up I can't even feel it. I dunno if this has any sleeping properties but the cooling effect helps me sleep like a baby 😴

Feels nice and hydrating & very reminiscent of the watermelon sleep mask from glow recipe. Feels nice and hydrating would definitely recommend

This really helped with my dry skin. It's amazing . It only takes a little amount and it's texture is great . No scent really which I love . Overall I like this moisturizer.
This sleeping mask is absolutely amazing! It's very soft and I can feel right away how it moisturizes my face, very good so far!

I love this brand so much after testing a few products courtesy of Influenster! This product smells nice, a tiny bit goes a long way & it's so dang moisturizing!!! Perfect for winter here in Washington state. My skin immediately sucked this product in and felt sooo soft! Thank you to Influenster & Belif for sending this out to me for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been looking for a new product to add to my skincare routine & omg this is the one! I love how much it hydrates my skin. I have combo sensitive skin so this is nice!

Almost feel like mask is a deceptive name for it. All that it say it felt great and hydrating. Although I'm not sure if I saw a difference in my skin each day using it.

I got this product to test out for free through influencer, and I love it. I've always been a huge Belif fan, this did not disappoint￼. I applied it over my normal evening routine, it's very light, holes in the moisture and it helped my skin look even more refreshed and glowing in the morning. ￼

I love how super light this felt on my face. The scent disappears quickly once applied. Didn't feel gross and heavy like some sleep masks I've tried. Washed off super easy and left my face feeling super soft and hydrated.
This works very well at hydrating my skin overnight. The only reason that I gave this 4/5 stars is because you have to rinse it off in the morning and I forget to do that often because I'm so busy
Can't recommend this product enough for people with dry skin! Wake up with your face so smooth and it's not heavy or sticky on your skin whatsoever

Let me start by saying, I love me some belif products. They are backed my science, and free of irritants, perfumes, and other shady ingredients. Their Aqua Bomb cream feels amazing on my skin, and is worth a purchase, especially for those with combination or oily skin. That's why I was stoked when I was chosen to try their Sleeping Mask. The mask promises lightweight, intense hydration, and it does just that. The texture is like a thick jelly, and it really does leave my skin dewy and fresh. Unfortunately, it wasn't enough moisture for my increasingly dry skin, as I found myself needed to layer an oil on top to keep the moisture in. I also hate to say it, but I'm pretty sure it caused some zits to pop up. Still, I totally recommend this. If you have combination skin that is not acne prone. It feels great and definitely provides intense moisture. ￼

This goes on so smoothly and feels so nice! The smell isn't bad like some skincare products, my skin feels so soft and hydrated afterwards, and I noticed my makeup going on much smoother and easier after using this! Definitely recommend!
This sleeping mask leaves your face feels super moisturized and soft. I love the way its feels so light on the skin. It also doesn't leave your face feeling oily at all.

avis.titre: Nice but not a new staple
avis.texte: I typically use Cerave Healing Ointment for slugging, and while this has a similar effect, I prefer the price point and fragrance free formula for the Cerave. The Belif one was nice to use while I had it, but it won't be an item I replace.
So hydrating! Leaves my skin feeling so soft, great for special events or during dryer times. Good for all skin types! Love it
This is one of the best sleeping masks I've used in a long time. Keeps my skin so hydrated, soft, and feeling like new. I love this brand and all their products.

Absolutely love this sleeping mask for an extra dose of hydration. Feels great going on, not sticky, smells great…can't say enough about it. A little goes a long way too. The sample size gets me a few uses. Will definitely be buying the full size.

avis.titre: This is now essential for me!
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with this! It smells so refreshing & it works wonders on my skin! Every time I use this, my skin is noticable more hydrated & it calms my blemishes over night! I love using face masks & I use this one more consistently than any other I own because it makes such a difference!

Love this product so very much.. i used there moisturizer bomb first then apply this mask.. its feel so good on and in the morning your skin is so soft and even toned .. plus its hydrating.. try is product youll be happy you did .. fan for life
Really great product! A little sticky so perfect for bed time applications and it fades fairly quickly so no worries about residue lingering or having things stick around!

Great moisturizer mask with minimal effort required. Just put it on and go to sleep and woke up with plumped and supple skin. Only downside is being a little sticky if you're sleeping on silk pillows - just sleep on your back and that should resolve it :)
I have always struggled with my skin being on the drier side, however with the Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask I no longer have that problem! My skin is now buttery smooth and more hydrated than ever!

I received this product in the mail for free. This is so moisturizing & good mask to use once a week, smells good & a little goes A long way. This is a good mask to use during a spa day, extra bouncy hydration skin
I have been using this the last couple months and it has made a good change in my skin. It feels smoother and more hydrated. I use it 1x a day! It's not oily and does not make me break out
This mask is really nice and soothing on the skin. Just apply a thin layer before bed and leave on over night. Next morning I wash off and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized.
I like this sleeping mask, but it dried my skin out a bit. I think I need to try it again, to make a more concise decision on whether I like it and want to use it regularly.

I love using sleep masks whenever the weather gets dry. It locks in all the serums and other goodies and doesn't feel uncomfortable while I'm trying to sleep. After washing my face in the morning, my face still retains its moisture.
This face mask makes my skin feel so bright and hydrsted. I got a free sample and had to buy the full size. So happy with this product!
Love the sleeping mask left skin feeling refreshed and not oily. Moisturized dry spots well, smelled nice also and didn't burn. Feels like a protective coat when you first put it on.

I loved how hydrating the products is and how simple it is to use. Just apply before bed. My cons about this product is how sticky the product is to use and how long it takes to set and dry. I even tried applying the thinnest layer and it took a long minute to dry.
